snippet.title: Ruadine Trailer
snippet.description:
'Ruadine' is a single player dungeon-crawler with a unique combat system. The game features a branching world to explore, mysterious monsters to defeat, and an atmospheric soundtrack. Coming soon to Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4183360

Play the in-browser demo or download the full game @ https://glasscandlegames.itch.io/ruadine

Find the soundtrack @ https://davidhendley.bandcamp.com
